label: Will
outcome: Lo studente usa will correttamente per previsioni/opinioni, decisioni prese sul momento e offerte/promesse scolasticamente rilevanti, costruendo affermative, negative e domande.
must_master: offer or promise in clear context

italian_learner_risks.risk: treating will as the automatic form for every future sentence
italian_learner_risks.target: choose will only when its meaning fits the context

context_bank: opinions about school or everyday future
messages about decisions made while speaking
quality_rejections: tomorrow used as an automatic answer key
more than two consecutive form-only items
ambiguous plan contexts better expressed with going to
